reviews.t: The gray now looks like beautiful highlights
reviews.x: I almost don't believe it but this stuff actually works. My hair is medium brown with about 50% gray. After only three shampoos the gray has taken on a golden brown color and has almost completely blended in with the darker brown. The gray now looks like beautiful highlights. I couldn't get color this good in a salon!

Love it! It definitely works. I have dark brown hair and now have subtle highlights of lighter brown, no red. At first I thought only I would notice the difference but people have commented that my hair looks lighter from the sun. Smells good and hair is soft and shiny, would totally buy again! obsessed!

reviews.t: My hair looks and smells amazing with this product
reviews.x: I used to use this shampoo and conditioner about 8 years ago. For the past few months I've been hopping around using different brands, and I saw this one pop up and had fond memories of it. And now? I don't know why I ever stopped using this product. It smells so good, I've never found another shampoo/conditioner that I liked the smell of more. I will say if you are sensitive to smells or perfumes it might not be the product for you. It also just works really well on my medium thick hair. Some p

I was excited to try this after I saw results from a friend using the blonde version of this product. I used it everyday for a week and then went back to my normal washing schedule. I could see results slowly. The top is my hair now, and the bottom is what it looked like before. I'm not sure if it's because of the red below my hair or the way the product works, but it has some copper tones to it. I don't mind though. I like it! I paired this with sun bum hair lightener spray. Another thing I not

reviews.t: One shade at best... no one notices.
reviews.x: As a guy with short hair I did not expect to see a huge difference, but I have to say, I am a bit disappointed. I used this in addition to the one time shower treatment, and then have been using both of these for the last few weeks. I would say my hair naturally lightens in the sun and these gave me about one shade and not much else. I think in the future I will avoid possible hair damage and just let the sun do its thing.
Shampoo does lighten but also dries hair a bit.  Conditioner leaves hair soft and I enjoy the smell. Does cause some brassiness and I wouldn't recommend you use it on freshly dyed hair.

This shampoo and conditioner set really works wonders in visibly brightening my hair color! The best part is that it didn’t make my hair brassy like most lighteners. And the conditioner really leaves your hair silky smooth and it smells amazing! I love this hair wash set!

I use this product twice a month in between Carol's Daughter's products.  Over time it has brought out my natural highlights and then enhances those.  I love giving my hair a boost without damage and the high cost of the beauty shop.

After years of coloring my hair, and because of the COVID-19 (don't go to hair salon) I decided to let my hair grow and get back to my original color. My hair was growing back but it was very dark whereas I was a natural blonde before I used all kinds of colorations.  It lightened the darker brown hair, and now I have reached light brown hair with golden blonde tones. It took me about 6 washes to notice a difference and it still continues to work. I also use the conditioner and my hair is soft a

I don’t understand this shampoo and conditioner set. It doesn’t have peroxide yet claims to lighten hair? I’m skeptical. I think it’s just a color depositing shampoo with a golden tint. I’m not sure the conditioner is anything special at all. It also made my hair feel like hay after using it, and the scent was unappealing to me. I went back to my normal Costco shampoo and conditioner.

I had very dark colored hair and wanted to lighten my hair. I used this set plus the recommended highlighter and my hair did get lighter 2 shades. I feel I only needed to purchae it once and I got the results I wanted. It is lightening your hair so dont expect this to smell good (it's not bad) and it wont leave your hair soft. But I used another conditioner after to help that.
I am a brunette with natural highlights and added ones. And I use this shampoo/conditioner daily.  My hair isn't orangey or gray. Just nice subtle highlights.
The products seems old and not brand new. There’s a rite aid sticker on the front and they have a strong smell like they’ve been in someone’s home.
I've used this product numerous times and have been very happy with the results. It gives my gray hairs (I have several) a slight blonde color.
I bought this to even out my hair color due to and old dye job. It did the job and my hair dresser even complimented me on my color.

This shampoo and conditioner set did add some subtle golden tones to my naturally medium brown hair. But don't think it's comparable to a salon. If someone hasn't seen you in a month, their first reaction isn't going to be, "OMG! Your hair is lighter!" You and possibly your significant other may notice. I was most impressed with how soft, shiny, and healthy my hair looked. Like incredible shine. Did not care for the scent which is supposed to be honey (I think) but it's not terrible. Will purcha

Even though it made my hair smell good, it’s not one of my favorites. It made my hair feel soft, both air dried and straightened.. haven’t curled it though so I can’t comment on how the curls held. I also didn’t notice much change in color of my hair so I wouldn’t purchase it, if that’s the outcome you’re looking for.

reviews.t: Not the best smelling but it’s ok!
reviews.x: Does exactly what it’s supposed to! It did take a couple washes for me to really notice it, without me saying “I can maybe see something,” every time I looked. Now I’ve been using for about 4 months and my hair which is usually a medium brown has visibly lighter highlights.

It does what it says.  Lightens each time a use it and brings out the light brown tones of my hair.  I can't find this in the stores anymore so I was excited to find it on Amazon.  I hope it is not  being discontinued.
I love this! It gradually lightens up my hair to a beautiful golden brunette! I had so many compliments on the color of my hair while using this!
Most of it has leaked down the drain. I've never had this happen before.
I love the different colors of brown it produces in my hair.

reviews.t: It’s worth trying if you want low maintenance highlights!
reviews.x: I love this!! Makes my grays turn into highlights!!
Asian hair do not waist time with it!!!!

It definitely lightened my color treated hair after one use. I've been using all sorts of different products and everything I read was correct about it. I don't care for the smell and even after using a deep conditioner afterwards my hair was a little dry. I will continue to use. Check containers after receiving for leaking. The conditioner wasn't completely closed.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product visibly lightens hair and brings out highlights, with many reporting it works as claimed.
Several reviewers praise the scent and how soft and shiny the conditioner leaves their hair.
A few reviewers report negative results, including brassiness, dryness, or hair feeling like hay.
Some reviewers note only subtle or minimal lightening, with little noticeable difference.
One reviewer received a product that seemed old and not brand new.
